whoItsFor: Developers using Claude Code who want compaction to keep exact file paths, errors, and commands instead of a lossy summary, and Node/TypeScript developers who want to prune long agent transcripts in their own apps.
useCases: Replace Claude Code's built-in /compact summary with the original messages, minus stale tool calls and results
Drop or truncate old tool results from long agent transcripts while keeping user and assistant text verbatim
Compact message histories in an npm-based app by passing a transcript to compactMessages

requirements.runtime: Claude Code 2.1.274+ for the plugin; npm package; TYPESAFE_API_KEY
